summary: Arbe Robotics filed a 6-K disclosing a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letter granting an additional 180-day period, until April 12, 2027, to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company previously received notice on April 13, 2026, after 30 consecutive below-$1.00 closes, and failed to cure by the initial October 12, 2026 deadline. Nasdaq found Arbe eligible based on market value of publicly held shares and other Capital Market criteria. Management is weighing options, including a reverse share split.
